# Ardena for Business

> Car rental and fleet management software for rental businesses in Kenya. One web dashboard for the fleet, bookings, renter ID verification, M-Pesa payment prompts, staff roles and finances, with an optional listing on the Ardena car rental app. Free for the first 2 months; renter verification checks are KES 100 each.

Ardena for Business (business.ardena.co.ke) is made by Ardena Platforms Africa Ltd, the company behind the Ardena car rental app (ardena.co.ke). It is built for car hire companies, self-drive and chauffeur rental operators, and corporate fleet owners in Kenya, from a handful of cars to large fleets.

Access is by request: Ardena verifies each business's registration and director details before issuing logins, so every business on the platform is a real, trading rental company.

## What it does

- Fleet management: every vehicle with its documents (logbook, insurance), insurance and inspection expiry reminders, day rates and availability.
- Bookings and reservations: create and track bookings with automatic double-booking checks, a pickup/return calendar, and handover check-out/check-in with odometer, fuel and condition photos.
- Renter verification: ID lookup, liveness and driving licence checks before a car leaves the yard.
- Payments: send an M-Pesa payment prompt from any booking; record cash; track what is collected and outstanding.
- Ardena app listing: list cars on the Ardena consumer car rental app. Ardena reviews every listing before renters can book it; renter bookings, messages, reviews, commission and payouts appear in the same dashboard.
- Staff and security: roles (Owner, Manager, Finance, Booking agent, Viewer), an activity log, optional two-step sign-in (codes by email or SMS), one-hour sessions, and OTP-verified payout accounts.
- Clients, chauffeurs, notifications, reports and monthly vehicle statements (PDF).

## Pricing

- Free for the first 2 months: every module, every vehicle, the whole team, no card required.
- Renter verification: KES 100 per check, pay as you go from a prepaid wallet.
- Ardena app bookings carry an Ardena commission; direct bookings made in the dashboard do not.

## Good fit for questions like

- Car rental management software / car hire software in Kenya
- Fleet management system for a rental or corporate fleet in Nairobi, Nakuru, Mombasa or Kisumu
- Car rental booking system with M-Pesa payments
- How to verify renters' ID and driving licence before renting out a car
- Software to list rental cars on a booking app and manage them from one dashboard
